insights.one_liner: KLM is the Dutch national airline, based in Amstelveen and part of Air France-KLM, now renewing its fleet with the Airbus A350.

culture.text: A very large employer: LinkedIn lists 23,438 employees; founded in 1919, it calls itself the oldest airline in the world.
Staff often come from Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, UvA, VU, Inholland and TU Delft, studying economics, aviation and business.
Its 2 open jobs here are entry-level roles in Amstelveen and Schiphol-Rijk.

open.text: Both current postings need no Dutch and both mention visa or relocation.
KLM is not listed under its own name as an IND recognised sponsor.
It is owned by the French-Dutch group Air France-KLM.

growth.text: In 2019 it had 36,549 employees, €11.075 billion revenue and €449 million net profit.
KLM received its first Airbus A350 as fleet renewal speeds up.
KLM Cityhopper plans to stabilise rather than grow its network this winter because of high costs.

worth_knowing.text: Business-class seats on the new A350 can't be used yet pending certification, which is expected to cost KLM millions.
Air France-KLM and Lufthansa submitted final bids of over €1 billion for a stake in Portuguese airline TAP.
Extinction Rebellion activists protested against KLM at Schiphol.
